meta.title: Model workbench
meta.description: Adds a Model workbench entry to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, showing the official Magpie GUI in the main area. The bundle page includes an install card: manually download and verify the official Magpie binary from GitHub, configure a permanent GitHub mirror, and detect other Magpie plugins inside DSH to avoid duplicates. The engine runs in a DSH-managed private directory with random ports and starts on demand; models can be synced to the DSH picker manually. Bundle removal follows DSH's official plugin lifecycle: removing this bundle from the Plugins panel only stops the engine process and never deletes the engine, data or settings under ~/.dsh.
